newsitem.title: USA: Manitowoc Q1 climbs as margins improve.
newsitem.headline: Manitowoc Q1 climbs as margins improve.

text.p: Manitowoc Co Inc said Thursday higher margins, lower interest expense and a lower tax rate helped earnings rise in the first quarter ended March 31.
The company reported net income of $6.5 million, or $0.56 a share, up from $4.1 million, or $0.36 a share, a year ago. Sales in the period rose to $116.0 million from $114.1 million, Manitowoc said.
Operating earnings from the company's crane business were nearly double year-ago results, Manitowoc said.
The company makes foodservice equipment, cranes, boom trucks and provides marine repair services.
Its shares were down 1/8 Thursday at 19-7/8.
